name: kit-cloud
description: See your Claude Code cloud sessions above the prompt: working, asking, PR open, CI failed or silent, with a link to each. The band for kit-cloud-pilot, which tracks them.

scope.title: Which sessions to show
scope.description: account+repo: this account's sessions in this repo. repo: every account's sessions in this repo. all: everything KIT Hub tracks.

autoWatch.title: Watch this repo
autoWatch.description: When a session starts in a GitHub repo, track each new claude/* branch by itself (needs node and a signed-in gh).

showBand.title: Show the band
showBand.description: Draw the cloud band above the prompt. Off keeps /cloud.

notifications.title: Desktop notifications (no session open)
notifications.description: Let the cloud-pilot hub show a system notification when a session needs you and no Claude session is open for it. Applies to tracks registered after you change it. While a session is open, see "Notify in this session".

notifyInSession.title: Notify in this session
notifyInSession.description: While this Claude session is open, show a message and a notification when a cloud session starts asking you a question, opens a PR, fails CI, goes silent or finishes.

deleteMergedBranches.title: Delete merged claude/* branches
deleteMergedBranches.description: After a tracked PR merges, delete its claude/* branch on GitHub, only while the branch still points at the merged commit.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto: follow Claude Code's own language setting (Vietnamese when it is set to Vietnamese, English otherwise). Or force en or vi. Read when a session starts.
